recipes.name: Angel Family Chicken Soup with Matzo Balls
ingredients_raw: 7 large carrots, cut into bite-size pieces
1 bunch celery, cut into bite-size pieces
3 parsnips, peeled and cut into bite-size pieces
1 rotisserie chicken, bones removed and meat cut into bite-size pieces

steps.text: Place whole chicken in a large stockpot; add 6 cups water, carrots, celery, parsnips, onion, dill, and parsley. Add more water as needed to cover ingredients; bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Cook until chicken begins to fall apart, about 1 hour. Remove chicken from soup and reserve for another use.

Whisk eggs and oil together in a medium bowl; stir in matzo meal until well combined. Cover the bowl; refrigerate for 20 minutes. Gently roll matzo mixture into 1-inch balls; be careful not to over roll as this can make matzo balls tough.

Bring 1 quart chicken stock to a boil in a separate large pot; reduce heat to a simmer. Gently add matzo balls to stock; cook until tender, about 1 hour. Transfer matzo balls to pot with soup and vegetables; season soup with salt and black pepper.
Place some rotisserie chicken meat in individual soup bowls; ladle in soup and matzo balls.

raw_recipe.headline: Angel Family Chicken Soup with Matzo Balls

review.reviewBody: I made this on a chilly, rainy day. I followed the recipe exactly except I left out the rotisserie chicken. What a perfect comfort food. I have also made this and strained everything out at the end so I was left with only broth and matza balls. It's even delicious that way! Either way this is a keeper! Thanks to the Angel Family!
This is AWESOME!!! I finally found a great recipe for my favorite chicken and "dumplings" dinners. Everyone who eats it raves about my fantastic "dumplings".

Only cheated a tiny bit and used a store bought rotisserie and used some chicken stock instead of using the raw chicken to save time. I then followed the recipe as written. My husband fell in love with this soup and said it was by far the BEST he has ever eaten. Thank you for sharing your recipe with our family!
A nice blend of comforting food! Made with 2 sweet potatoes as recommended by someone else.

Marvelous Chicken and Matzo Ball Soup! It's my "go to" when I start feeling like I'm coming down with a cold. I start feeling better every time! Thank you for sharing this wonderful family tradition! :)

I make at least 2 soups a week in Winter and I have been craving some new soup that I wasn't sure what that craving was. After 3 days of cruising recipes on and off, I came upon this one. I knew instantly that Matzo Ball soup was that craving!! Well, I just made it and it hit right on spot and more! Yum, yum and Yummly!
I think I didn't add enough water...it ended up being not so much of a soup...

This soup was very delicious! I followed the recipe exactly but I didn't cook the chicken in the water with the veggies. Even though I didn't do this, it still came out fantastic! However, someone made this soup and cooked the chicken with the veggies and it gave the soup a very nice flavor! In the end, it was the best matzo soup I've ever made!
